Definition: an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum)
BiblicalUsage: 1) dwelling, habitation, refuge; 1a) lair, refuge (of jackals); 1b) dwelling
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
